artifact: Block-Five Layer-A trial-fill — BATCH 1 (schema pre-freeze pilot) — v0.3, targets schema v0.1.3
supersedes: block_five_trialfill_batch1_v0_2.json (pre-fold record, byte-untouched; targeted schema v0.1.2, 7 rows / 0 violations / 1 advisory flag). This v0.3 batch is drafted against the owner-ruled schema v0.1.3 (two merged rulings): ruling 1 SCHEMA-R4 promotes AITRADER-SCOPE-FIDELITY from v0.2 documented-exclusion to a first-class row_kind='no-enforcement-point' row; ruling 2 deletes the HERMES delivery-only row's optional low-confidence grounding fragment to a clean analysis-absent row. Net: 8 rows / target 0 violations / 0 advisory flags.

batch_header.purpose: This batch is the block-five schema's PRE-FREEZE PILOT, not a companion to the freeze. The block-five schema is a TABLE contract, so real rows must friction the schema BEFORE it freezes: an enum that cannot hold reality is a one-line JSON fix now rather than a v0.1.2 + erratum + correction-log entry later. selftest fixtures prove the ASSERTIONS fire; these trial-fill rows prove the SCHEMA HOLDS REALITY — the complementary half. The v0.1 batch surfaced SCHEMA-R3 (no delivery-only row shape); the owner ruled R3=B (narrowed), CF-1, CF-2; this v0.2 batch is drafted against the resulting schema v0.1.2.
batch_header.layer_scope: Layer-A ONLY (static delivery-representability audit; no execution). Does NOT touch QEMC v0.1.1 §1 ('once quantitative data collection begins, definitions may not change'): NONE of Q3-Q10 is produced here. No Layer-B field appears on any row (FW-A-NO-B-FIELDS must pass for every row).
batch_header.layer_b_prohibition: NO Layer-B row may be filled before the schema itself freezes and signs — INCLUDING the SLEEVE cell whose Q3/Q5/Q7 numbers are already computed (QEMC dry-run products). Admitting them into a Layer-B table before the table contract freezes would open the 'data precedes contract' seam. Layer-B (SLEEVE cell first) is the LAST step of the execution order, after freeze + trial-fill promotion.

status_discipline.preflight_only: These rows pass validator PREFLIGHT but DO NOT enter the evidence face. They are draft feedstock for paper table-ization and schema pressure-testing.
status_discipline.mandatory_reverify_after_freeze: After the schema freeze settles, EVERY trial-fill row is re-run through the validator AGAINST THE FROZEN BYTES; a row is promoted to evidence-face only on re-verify pass. Because the schema DID change bytes before freeze (v0.1.1 -> v0.1.2 from this pilot's R3 feedback), the re-verify is MANDATORY, NOT ceremonial: rows were re-drafted against v0.1.2 and must be re-checked against whatever the owner finally signs.

batch_header.coverage_target: Coverage-oriented, not quantity-oriented. Goal: each key enum value stepped on by >=1 real data row. Target = all 3 structural_verdict values, >=2 delivery_failure_family values, >=3 grounding_class values.

structural_verdict.note: fully-representable + collision-found carried by the constraint-audit rows; 'unresolved' carried by the HERMES delivery-only row. The AITRADER no-enforcement-point row carries NO structural_verdict by rule (NO-EP-VERDICT-EMPTY: nothing-to-analyze is not an analysis outcome), so it does not and must not contribute to verdict coverage.

delivery_failure_family.gap: weakening — no pin-settled Vibe exemplar yet; acceptable gap, do NOT fabricate a row to hit the enum.

grounding_class.gap: other + latent-purpose. HONEST DELTA FROM v0.2: v0.2 reported 4/5 because the HERMES delivery-only row carried a low-confidence grounding_class='other' fragment; ruling 2 deleted that fragment, so 'other' is no longer stepped by any row. No pin-settled CONSTRAINT-AUDIT instance classifies as 'other' (the only 'other' was an optional delivery-only residue, never load-bearing), and the only 'latent-purpose' exemplar (spoofing) is a rubric probe, not a pin-settled constraint. Both are acceptable gaps; do NOT fabricate a row to reclaim enum coverage.
grounding_class.coverage_principle_reaffirmed: Owner rule: reality has an instance => add a row; reality has none => record as acceptable gap. Reclaiming 'other' by keeping a noise fragment would be using arbitration-noise to fake enum coverage — the opposite of the discipline.

coverage_report.coverage_principle: Owner rule: reality has an instance => add a row; reality has none => record as acceptable gap here. Never fabricate a row to hit enum coverage (that is using fake data to give a real contract a checkup).

resolved_findings.ruling: Row granularity = one row per (constraint x analyzed_layer). analyzed_layer added as an explicit scalar, bidirectionally coupled to row_kind (constraint-audit ⟺ analyzed_layer in candidate_layers; delivery-only ⟺ analyzed_layer empty).
resolved_findings.effect_on_this_batch: Each constraint-audit row now carries an explicit analyzed_layer (model/guard) that is a member of its candidate_layers; the delivery-only row has no analyzed_layer.

resolved_findings.ruling: owner-ruled, standing-directive backed ('do it complete, ignore the clock'); merged with ruling 2 into a SINGLE v0.1.3 byte-flip.
resolved_findings.schema_change: v0.1.2 -> v0.1.3: added a THIRD row_kind 'no-enforcement-point'. Requires constraint IDENTITY (same 4 subfields as delivery-only) + deployment + evidence + row_kind + a REQUIRED mediation_evidence pointer (F1-FAIL verdict + hash). The representation-analysis group is FORBIDDEN (NO-EP-NO-REPR, key appearance incl. null). structural_verdict MUST be ABSENT (NO-EP-VERDICT-EMPTY) — NOT 'unresolved': 'unresolved'=analysis-deferred, no-enforcement-point=nothing-to-analyze; conflation pollutes verdict statistics. analyzed_layer MUST be empty (CF2 3-way). Constraint-analysis + delivery groups permitted-absent.
resolved_findings.why_isomorphic_to_R3B: Refusing to table the AI-Trader observation while tabling delivery-only would let this table express only HALF of the paper's enforcement-point-vacuum thesis. SLEEVE rows = 'layer exists but representation-blind' (form 1); AITRADER = 'no action-time enforcement layer exists at all' (form 2, F1_shadow_guard_replay=FAIL). Excluding form 2 divorces the claim from half its evidence — the same argument that carried R3=B.
resolved_findings.effect_on_this_batch: AITRADER-SCOPE-FIDELITY re-drafted as a clean row_kind='no-enforcement-point' row (representation group + structural_verdict removed; mediation_evidence added pointing to ai_trader_fcheck_verdicts_v0_1.json sha256 799c1a32.. F1=FAIL_REPLICATION_ARM). It now validates with ZERO violations under v0.1.3 — the schema HOLDS the enforcement-point-vacuum reality instead of excluding it to prose.

resolved_findings.ruling: owner-ruled (ruling 2): delete the HERMES delivery-only row's optional grounding fragment (grounding_class='other'/confidence='low').
resolved_findings.schema_change: NONE — batch-only change, zero schema byte. delivery-only permits grounding-absent; the fragment was optional, not required.
resolved_findings.why_delete_not_keep: A low-confidence 'other'/low grounding fragment on a delivery-only row (a) triggers the arbitration route by rubric (a delivery-only row dragging an arbitration obligation = process noise for zero information), and (b) is not 'partial analysis' — the hermes constraint text is in hand (74% dropped paragraphs visible in issue #46823), so grounding, if done, should be done in full, not left as a low-confidence residue that burdens a future annotator to either ignore or redo. Deleting to a clean analysis-absent row keeps the promotion path open: fill the full grounding triple and pass CLASS-TEST-CONSISTENT to convert to full analysis later, honestly.
resolved_findings.effect_on_this_batch: The HERMES-TRUNC-46823@delivery row loses grounding_class / grounding_matched_test / grounding_evidence_span / grounding_confidence. It remains a valid clean delivery-only row (identity + delivery + deployment + evidence + structural_verdict='unresolved'), and no longer raises an advisory flag. Advisory-flag count 1 -> 0.
resolved_findings.advisory_flag_positive_note: The advisory flag did its designed job here: the machine pushed a fence-sitting low-confidence classification to a human for adjudication rather than silently admitting it. This is a POSITIVE design-validation case (recorded in Standing_Correction_Log ADVISORY-FLAG-POSITIVE), not a defect.

documented_exclusions.was: In v0.2 this observation was forced OUT by the 2-kind enum {constraint-audit, delivery-only} and recorded as a documented census exclusion with a JUDGMENT-CALL flag for the owner (third row_kind belongs to v0.1.3, rule it explicitly).
documented_exclusions.now: Owner ruled SCHEMA-R4: it is a first-class row_kind='no-enforcement-point' row (see rows[] and resolved_findings SCHEMA-R4). No block-five observation is now documentation-only excluded; the table expresses both forms of the enforcement-point vacuum.
documented_exclusions.anti_proliferation_check: The new kind satisfies the schema's row_kind_anti_proliferation_rule: it was triggered by THIS real, existing row (AITRADER-SCOPE-FIDELITY) that no existing kind could honestly hold — not a speculative reservation.
